legend: The infiltrate involves the subcutaneous tissue and spares the overlying dermis and epidermis (<<36415>>). Atypical cells rim fat spaces; macrophages are increased in number and contain apoptotic debris (<<36416>>). High magnification shows atypical medium-sized lymphocytes with karyorrhectic debris rimming the subcutaneous fat lobules (<<32338>>).
Multiple subcutaneous nodules are common on the extremities. The overlying epidermis may show mild to moderate erythema (<<36414>>). Subcutaneous nodules and lipoatrophy (<<36315>>).
